brief:
Displaced Palestinians in western Gaza are maintaining vigilant watch over military activity in their neighborhoods, Shehab Wire reported. Residents have grown accustomed to tracking vehicle and motorcycle movements throughout the area, remaining alert to suspicious timing and routes that could signal hostile operations. The practice has become embedded in daily life as people navigate streets where displaced families have congregated.

The monitoring reflects the conditions facing civilians in Gaza, where anticipating threats has become necessary amid displacement and ongoing conflict. Such vigilance has become routine as Palestinians attempt to protect themselves and gather intelligence on military presence in their communities. Residents describe the practice as a form of self-defense in an environment where conventional safety measures are unavailable.
